title: Midea Cube 50 Pint Dehumidifier, Built-in Pump, Drain Hose, Smart/Alexa
histogram_note: Bimodal: 52% 5-star vs 23% 1-star — 'works great or dies' reliability-failure signature.

critical_patterns.theme: 50-pint Cube fails ~1 year; pump is the weak point
critical_patterns.evidence: linux4me(4★): 'two 50-pinters failed at about the one-year mark; one of the 20-pinters still going after almost two years'; sw21212(1★): 'Don't buy the one with a pump! Not Midea high quality'; WillyWonker(1★): 'Died after a week, loud hammering noise'
critical_patterns.verdict: CONFIRMED dealbreaker for the 50-pint PUMP model — does NOT implicate the smaller pumpless Cubes

critical_patterns.evidence: sw21212: '1.5 hrs with Midea reps, pump instructions incomplete/incorrect'

key_takeaway: The low star average is pump/large-capacity-driven. User needs a SMALL PUMPLESS gravity-drain unit, which avoids this failure mode. Steer toward Midea Cube 20 or 35 pint (no pump). Verify small-Cube longevity on Reddit.
representative_reviews: WillyWonker 1★ (2023-06-25, Verified): 'Died after a week. Loud hammering noise in the middle of the night. Sending it back.'
linux4me 4★ (2024-05-25, Verified): 'Third 50-pint Cube I've owned... two prior 50-pinters failed at ~1yr. One 20-pinter still going after ~2yr.' (longevity differs by capacity tier)
sw21212 1★ (2023-10-06, Verified): 'Don't buy the one with a pump! Not Midea high quality. 1.5 hrs with reps, pump instructions incomplete/incorrect.'
Winona 5★ (2026-04-30, Verified): 'Works like a charm and keeps working. In our cellar... did a great job.'
Foghorn Leghorn 5★ (2025-07-28, Verified): 'Best dehumidifier this side of a professional machine. Pump model weirdly cheaper than non-pump.'
